name: Sheshai
overview: Sheshai was a male descendant of Anak, known for being one of the three sons of Anak whom Joshua drove out from Kiriath-arba. His identity is closely tied to this familial and historical context as recorded in the Old Testament. Beyond his lineage, little else about his tribe or surname is specified in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Sheshai is a proper name meaning 'noble.' This designation does not appear to have been given directly by God but reflects the Hebrew meaning as recorded in Numbers 13:22.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Sheshai as a son of Anak. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this direct filial connection.
scriptureSignificance: Sheshai's significance lies in his association with the Anakim, a formidable group of giants descended from Anak. As one of the sons driven out by Joshua from Kiriath-arba, Sheshai represents the opposition faced by the Israelites during their conquest of Canaan. His mention underscores God's faithfulness in delivering the Promised Land to His people by overcoming intimidating adversaries.
